title: customers.consent.grant payload
description: One consent FACT. `notice_text` is required because a consent whose wording nobody can produce is precisely the consent that cannot be demonstrated (GDPR art. 7.1, EDPB 05/2020 §108: the information provided to the data subject at the time shall be demonstrable). The screen supplies it from its own catalogue, so nobody types it.

purpose.description: What the consent is FOR. `marketing` unless the hub asks for something else; transactional messages need no consent and must never be filed under one.

channel.description: `any` is deliberately NOT accepted: it exists only for the legacy backfill, which is the one row nobody can attribute to a channel.

contact_point.description: The address it was given for, as it was then. A corrected email is not covered by the consent given for the old one.

notice_text.description: The exact words shown, stored verbatim. Not a reference: catalogues change and «the text that was on screen in January» is not recoverable from today's.

evidence.description: Anything external that backs it up: a signed form's reference, a ticket number.

occurred_at.description: When the PERSON said it, if that is not now — a form signed yesterday.
